title: Snooze Station
slugLine: A Belkin device that fits in the palm of a hand and gives travelers quality sleep anywhere, with natural light, calming sounds and MagSafe charging.

image.alt: Snooze Station on a wooden nightstand in a dark bedroom, its base glowing warm amber, with a phone docked on it showing a clock and a calendar.

research.problem: While traveling, we lose ==our ideal conditions for restorative sleep==: **an unfamiliar room disrupts the natural circadian rhythm and sleep schedule**.

stakeholders.name: Frequent travelers
stakeholders.note: Persona: Max, 30, who travels often for work and leisure

painPoints.label: Harsh light
painPoints.detail: Harsh overhead lighting in an unfamiliar room.

painPoints.label: Noise outside
painPoints.detail: Loud sound from outside the room.

painPoints.label: A broken wind-down
painPoints.detail: They cannot sleep comfortably because their wind-down routine is disrupted the moment they leave home.

painPoints.label: Jet lag
painPoints.detail: Travel and jet lag disrupt the environmental cues that regulate the circadian rhythm.

painPoints.label: Screens and blue light
painPoints.detail: LED screens and blue light throw off the circadian rhythm.

insights.evidence: The body has a natural clock calibrated by the wavelengths of light it is exposed to. Overexposure to blue light disrupts it, while warm amber or orange light can recalibrate it.

insights.insight: Sleep comes when pressure and timing agree
insights.evidence: Sleep begins when sleep pressure and circadian timing favor it; wakefulness begins when sleep pressure falls and circadian alerting signals rise.

insights.insight: Relaxing tells the body it is time
insights.evidence: Lying down in bed and clearing one’s head of thoughts tells the body to enter a sleepy state.

design.lead: Snooze Station recreates the ideal conditions for restorative sleep with a Belkin product: light, sound and charging in one object that keeps the wind-down routine consistent across any room and time zone.

rows.label: Adaptive light
cells: Warm amber for winding down, red for the middle of the night, and a slow warm ramp in the morning instead of an alarm that jolts you
Smooths the move between wakefulness and sleep by simulating the wavelengths of natural light

rows.label: Bluetooth speaker
cells: Plays sounds from a wellness or streaming app: white noise, calming sounds and alarms
A consistent sleep environment without headphones or earbuds

rows.label: Multi-device charging
cells: The phone charges on the MagSafe plate at an angle; earbuds and other devices charge on the base
Keeps the nightstand setup simple and cable-free

rows.label: Portable form
cells: The charging pad folds flat, and at 4" × 1.9" it fits in a palm and packs easily in a bag
Sets up quickly in any room

rows.label: Simple controls
cells: Buttons on the device adjust light brightness and sound volume
No need to reach for the phone

Snooze Station with a phone on its tilted MagSafe plate and an earbuds case charging on its base, the base glowing warm.

items.title: Settle the room
items.body: Make the environment feel safe and comfortable, from 9:15 PM (15 min).

items.title: Sleep aid
items.body: Take a sleep aid or a drink (10 min).

items.title: End of day
items.body: Take care of end-of-day logistics (30 min).

items.title: Lie down
items.body: Lie down or recline (2 hr 15 min).

items.title: Wind down
items.body: Wind down with relaxing activities, with Snooze Station.

items.title: Arrive
items.body: Set it on the hotel bedside table.

items.title: Dock and choose a sound
items.body: Dock the phone and pick a soundscape, such as Deep Sleep, in the companion app; it plays over Bluetooth.

items.title: Wind down
items.body: The room darkens and the warm light comes on.

items.title: Wake up
items.body: The light changes over for the morning.

items.title: Pack up
items.body: Turn it off, unplug it and stow the portable puck in a carry-on.

image.alt: Seven companion app screens: a sleep time schedule, a wind-down routine that dims the lights, fades in a sleep sound and reminds you to dock your phone, light scenes named Candle, Sunset, Reading and Night, and a sounds screen.
